exact_result: Strict maximal-residue finiteness reconstructed; contracted relative Tate presentation proved finite with its Banach topology; pure one-dimensional finite fibre-product carrier proved surjective; local open-edge smoothing repaired with positive tolerances. No intrinsic universal curve recognition theorem is claimed.
concrete_gaps: R0 remains unproved in its exact every-field/every-pure-curve/every-open scope.

Thuillier Dirichlet and harmonic functoriality: semistable model existence/domination, quasi-finite model extension and pointwise residual weighted degree identities remain essential upstream obligations.
Wanner 4.6/4.7: model-test realization, formal metric extension, semistable domination, very ample decomposition and model/MA comparison remain separate from the repaired smoothing step.

The ordinary-current transport/calibration argument T is not certified; Ducros finite polyhedrality still has explicit Gerritzen-Grauert, local-algebraization, definability and germ-reduction dependencies.
Full boundary descent has nested graded-reduction dependencies; only the weaker boundary inclusion is needed for the identified harmonic-majorant comparison.

No GJR/real-PL, P0, all-analytic-extension ordinary-current ascent, two-sign ordinary smooth psh regularization, or harmonic approximants are proved; original arbitrary-dimensional P06.2 remains open.
